source.title: BLUEFIN: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Financial Spreadsheets

issues.problem: "On the small public set, the open models Kimi K2.6 (42.3) and MiniMax M2.5 (20.9) trail the closed ones." Table 5 shows Kimi K2.6 (42.3) well ahead of the closed model Grok (23.3). The open models do not uniformly trail the closed ones.
issues.suggestion: Rephrase to match Table 5. For example: "On the small public set, the open models Kimi K2.6 (42.3) and MiniMax M2.5 (20.9) trail Opus, GPT-5.5, Sonnet and Gemini, though Kimi still beats Grok (23.3)."
